content:
file#CategoryTheory/Preadditive/Mat defines both docs#CategoryTheory.Mat_ and docs#CategoryTheory.Mat.

I don't know if this is the same, but we previously had Mon_/Mod_/Grp_ and those were renamed (see #mathlib4 > Removing underscores from docs#Mon_, docs#Grp_ ... and #28406 / #38342 / #38577).

Does it make sense to rename Mat_ as well? (perhaps Mat/MatCat like the existing Grp/GrpCat, idk)
The underscore causes strange names, e.g. docs#CategoryTheory.Functor.mapMat__obj_X has a double underscore.
Would this mean banishing terminal _ in defs (or even all user-facing decls) in general? (That sounds reasonable to me.)

I'll flag that it's probably worth engaging with this part of the module doc, which suggests a need for two separate Mat-ish things:

Future work

We should provide a more convenient Mat R, when R is a ring,
as a category with objects n : FinType,
and whose morphisms are matrices with components in R.

Ideally this would conveniently interact with both Mat_ and Matrix.

And of course we should ping @Kim Morrison, as she's the author on that file :)

Oh, looking at the history the TODO was introduced with the module in !3#6845, and a year later !3#12617 added Mat. So this TODO is probably referring to the existing Mat that I mentioned and can be deleted.

@Kim Morrison @Joël Riou do you have any suggestions/objections for the rename?
My previous attempt to rename stuff in category theory did not end well (#39906)

These Mat_ and Mat are two distinct definitions. If C is a preadditive category Mat_ C is the category of "formal finite (bi)products" of objects in C (this is a kind of categorical version of block matrices). If R is a ring Mat R identifies to the category of finitely generated free R-modules, with rectangular matrices with coefficients in R as morphisms. Mat R is equivalent to a particular case of Mat_ (with C the category with one object that has R as endomorphisms). Defining the equivalence could be nice, but I do not think it would be advisable to refactor Mat to make it an abbrev for a suitable Mat_.
Then, I am not sure what rename you would like to do?

Joël Riou said:

Then, I am not sure what rename you would like to do?

Come up with 2 names for these that don't include an underscore.
For example Grp_ was renamed to GrpCat, so we could do MatCat/MatObj/MatClass/Mat'.
I don't know enough about this to know which name makes sense, but a trailing underscore doesn't fit the naming convention and there's now a linter against it.
Joël, your explanation makes it sound like Mat_ should be renamed to Mat and Mat to MatCat

One issue with MatCat is that it is inconsistent with other names FooCat where Foo refers to the objects of the category (e.g. ModuleCat, AlgCat), while objects of MatCat have nothing to do with matrices.
